contentText:
Billboard Latin Music Week 2026 brought the heat to Miami, capping the week with Billboard En Vivo, an unforgettable night of live performances, culture and fan-first experiences at Wynwood Marketplace. Headliners Jay Wheeler and Zhamira delivered standout sets, with Conep opening the show and setting the tone for the night.

Billboard En Vivo was presented by Sonesta International Hotels, the official hotel sponsor of Billboard Latin Music Week 2026. Sonesta Travel Pass members received exclusive access, including a dedicated lounge experience designed to bring fans closer to the music and the moments moving Latin culture forward.

Not a Sonesta Travel Pass member? Join Sonesta Travel Pass .

Tetris Kelly: Miami turned up the heat as Billboard Latin Music Week brought together some of the biggest names and influential voices shaping the future of Latin music. This year, Sonesta took center stage as the presenting sponsor of Wednesday night’s Billboard En Vivo event, bringing music, culture and exclusive experiences together. As the official hotel sponsor of Billboard Latin Music Week 2026, Sonesta International Hotels provided Sonesta Travel Pass members with exclusive access and experiences that took the night to the next level. Billboard En Vivo, presented by Sonesta International Hotels, brought the energy to Wynwood Marketplace for an unforgettable celebration of Latin music. The lineup featured headliners Jay Wheeler and Zhamira, with opening act Conep, delivering an exciting night filled with incredible performances and the sounds of Latin music. The exclusive Sonesta Travel Pass Lounge offered an intimate private space right on the ground. From unforgettable performances to exclusive member experiences, Sonesta International Hotels and Billboard Latin Music Week brought people closer to the music, the culture and the moments that move Latin music forward.
